facts.text: The FlightforgeSimulator component passes the node name 'mrs_uav_flightforge_simulator' to its rclcpp::Node constructor.
The shipped launch starts the component in an empty namespace with the node name 'flightforge_simulator'.
The node publishes rosgraph_msgs::msg::Clock on the private topic ~/clock_out.
The shipped launch remaps ~/clock_out to the absolute /clock topic.
timerMain advances sim_time_ by one clock step (1/clock_rate) and publishes a rosgraph_msgs::msg::Clock message on every main-timer tick.
The shipped config sets simulation_rate to 100.0 Hz and clock_rate to 400.0 Hz, with a comment that clock_rate should be at least simulation_rate.
timerMain calls publishPoses after stepping every UAV that has not crashed, once at least one simulation step of sim time has passed since the last step.
The node publishes geometry_msgs::msg::PoseArray on the private topic ~/uav_poses_out.
The shipped launch remaps ~/uav_poses_out to the private topic ~/uav_poses.
publishPoses writes the current sim_time_ into the PoseArray header stamp, the configured world frame name into frame_id, and one pose per UAV from its position and attitude.
The shipped config names the world frame 'simulator_origin'.
The shipped uav list contains one UAV named uav1.
The node registers yaml_prefix + 'paused' through dynparam_mgr_->register_param with &drs_params_.paused, the literal false and callbackPause.
timerInit sets drs_params_.paused to false.
callbackPause cancels timer_main_ and timer_status_ when the paused parameter is true, and recreates both timers when it is false.
timerInit constructs one mrs_multirotor_simulator::UavSystemRos on this node for every name in uav_names.
timerInit creates a GameModeController for LOCALHOST port 8551 and, while rclcpp::ok(), retries Connect() every second, logging an error about Unreal's game mode controller.
timerInit creates the ~/clock_out and ~/uav_poses_out publisher handlers and then the main wall timer with period 1 / (clock_rate * realtime_factor).

The hw_api launch remaps the plugin's simulator command outputs (actuators, control group, attitude rate, attitude, acceleration, velocity, position and tracker commands) to /flightforge_simulator/<uav_name>/ topics.
The hw_api plugin's callbackArming stores armed_ and returns success for both an arm and a disarm request.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned replies; no FlightForge (Unreal Engine) process, physics step, sensor renderer, wall-clock pacing or state-hash replay. The fake is not a capture of live ROS traffic.

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free contract fake with canned placeholder replies (no physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport: it answers the declared /clock and /flightforge_simulator/uav_poses subscriptions with placeholder constants and runs no FlightForge process, simulation step, physics, sensors, renderer or ROS graph
the clock and pose values are placeholders and do not advance or move; a live run must receive the upstream node's own samples

the upstream node creates the clock and pose publishers only after timerInit has connected to the FlightForge binary on localhost port 8551, which it retries every second without a limit (src/flightforge_simulator.cpp:894-905, 1183-1196); without the running binary, and while the paused parameter is true, both topics are silent and both reads time out

the per-UAV command topics under /flightforge_simulator/<uav_name>/ (actuators, attitude, velocity, position and tracker commands), which the node's UavSystemRos objects (outside the clone) consume and the hw_api plugin publishes, are NOT COVERED; a ROS topic publication would be transmission-only and the clone has no acknowledged stop for it

the dynamic parameter mrs_uav_flightforge_simulator/paused is NOT COVERED: ROS parameter access is not a rosbridge opcode and the clone does not declare the parameter-service type for a source-cited binding

the hw_api plugin and its arming/offboard callbacks (callbackArming only stores a flag and answers success), per-UAV odom/imu/rangefinder topics, lidar and camera topics, camera_info, TF and the external FlightForge binary are NOT COVERED
the package declares no native stop; the stock e-stop latches this observation profile and reports software_only, not a stopped simulator
no live ROS 2 graph, rosbridge connection, simulator execution or hardware run has been performed; the fake evidence remains contract_checked

measures.description: Read one simulated clock sample published by the FlightForge node
measures.name: read_sim_clock

measures.description: Read one UAV pose array published by the FlightForge node
measures.name: read_uav_poses

safe_state.description: No acknowledged ROS service or action stop exists in the pinned clone: this observation-only profile has no native stop, and the stock e-stop only latches it (software-only) without claiming that the simulator node, its UAV models or the external FlightForge (Unreal Engine) process stopped.
